detail.longDescription: RE: https:// mstdn.social/@Nigel_Purchase/1 17192254887520632 Maybe Parliamentary inquiries shouldn’t publish crap… ? The Guardian reports a process for & results of testing submissions to Parliamentary inquiries: “The submissions containing AI-generated material range from documents with a small number of incorrect citations to submissions in which every reference cited does not exist. They were authored by individuals and organisations across the political spectrum. “When Guardian Australia contacted the people and organisations responsible, many were unaware AI could get things wrong in this way or were aware of the potential for errors but had missed them before submitting the document.” # ParliamentaryInquiries # submissions # AusPol # AI # LLMs # Google # ChatGPT # whyPublishCrap
